gloss: spare time; on the side; sideline; incidentally

definitions.gloss: spare time; on the side; sideline
definitions.explanation: Doing something as a secondary activity while one's main attention is elsewhere; treating something as a side project rather than a primary focus.

examples.japanese: {片手間|かたてま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧だ。
examples.english: It's rude to do the work half-heartedly.

examples.japanese: {片手間|かたてま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{本腰|ほんごし}→本腰：30604_hongoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んで→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧ほしい。
examples.english: I want you to tackle it seriously, not as a sideline.

notes:
{片手間|かたてま} refers to doing something as a secondary activity.

FORMS:
- ⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧ (one of a pair, partial) + ⟦{手間|てま}→手間：03554_tema⟧ (time/effort)
- Literally: partial effort, using only "one hand"

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {片手間|かたてま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧/⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ + verb: doing something on the side
- {片手間|かたてま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: something done as a sideline

USAGE:
Can be neutral (describing a side activity) or negative (implying lack of dedication):
- Neutral: {片手間|かたてま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{副業|ふくぎょう}→副業：08479_fukugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ (I have a side job)
- Negative: {片手間|かたてま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧な (Don't do it half-heartedly)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {片手間|かたてま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: side work
- {片手間|かたてま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧: to do on the side
- {片手間|かたてま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧: to deal with casually

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本腰|ほんごし}→本腰：30604_hongoshi⟧: serious effort, full commitment
